Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Oblong End/Side/Nesting Tables, Firwood
Colors: Firwood
Materials: Engineered Wood
Global-inspired wood grain patterns give these nesting tables an eye-catching finish, while the oblong shape and angled legs are mid-century inspired. This handsome pair can hold snack trays and remote controls, or stack together to save room. Large: 46.87x23.25x22; Small 31.5x15.75x19.25 Engineered wood and fiberboard Mid-century with globally-inspired touches Can nestle together to accommodate small spaces Simple assembly in 30 minutes or less; just screw on legs Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
